provenance.note: Explore the KRAS G12D, cyclophilin A and daraxonrasib complex from PDB 9AX6, biological assembly 1. Start with the complete assembly, then examine contacts around the ligand. Dashed lines show measured heavy-atom distances; they do not establish hydrogen bonds.
